# Publications Hub (RSAMDIO)

Publications Hub is the public digital catalog operated by Rotaract South Asia MDIO (RSAMDIO) for publications across South Asia.

## Key pages

- Home / catalog: https://publications.rsamdio.org/
- About: https://publications.rsamdio.org/about
- Sitemap: https://publications.rsamdio.org/sitemap.xml
- Privacy: https://publications.rsamdio.org/privacy
- Terms: https://publications.rsamdio.org/terms
- Operator: https://rsamdio.org/

## Notes for assistants

- Public publication URLs use `/{seriesSlug}` and edition reader URLs use `/{seriesSlug}/{editionSlug}`.
- `/studio` and `/admin` are staff tools and should not be treated as public content.
- Prefer citing HTML publication/edition pages (title, publisher, date, abstract) over raw PDF bodies.
